title: Renaming Pack for MSKLI
description: Adds some Vanilla Item Renamings. Made for MSKLI server.
body:
Renaming Pack for MSKLI is a Resource Pack that allows you to rename some Items and thus change their Models and/or Textures.

You can customize it using the [Resource Pack Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/respackopts) mod.

<details>
<summary>Here is a list of some of the Item Renamings:</summary>

Miscellaneous
| Item/Item Type                             | Name                                  |
|--------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------|
| Rotten Flesh                               | `Chips`/`Crisps`                      |
| Shield/Totem of Undying                    | `Wedding Ring`                        |
| Spyglass                                   | `Binoculars`                          |
| Carved Pumpkin (only model in hand/on head)| `Top Hat`/`High Hat`/`Topper`         |
|                                            | `Top Hat +1`/`High Hat +1`/`Topper +1`|
| Helmets (with item texture) (requires [Variants CIT](https://modrinth.com/mod/variants-cit))| `Top Hat`/`High Hat`/`Topper`         |

LambdaRepublic'sCraft
| Item/Item Type                                             | Name                      |
|------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------|
| Books                                                      | `Passport`                |
| Bread                                                      | `Fried Bread`             |
|                                                            | `Overfried Bread`         |
|                                                            | `Overoverfried Bread`     |
|                                                            | `Kirieshki`               |
|                                                            | `Pack of Kirieshkis`      |
| Iron Ingot                                                 | `Vacuum Packer`           |
| Paper                                                      | `Empty Pack of Kirieshkis`|
| Diamond/Diamond Ores/Diamond Block (only the model in hand)| `Lambdit`                 |
| Diamond Ores/Diamond Block (only the model in hand)        |`Block of Lambdits`        |
| Swords/Mace                                                | `Frying Pan`              |
| Torches (only the model in hand)                           | `Match`                   |
|                                                            | `Lighted Match`           |

From the "Fried igrobzik" mod
| Item/Item Type               | Name                       |
|------------------------------|----------------------------|
| Books                        | `Recipe Book`              |
| Food                         | `Half a Lemon`             |
|                              | `Igrobzik Flesh`           |
|                              | `Igrobzik Heart`           |
|                              | `Igrobzik`                 |
|                              | `Fried igrobzik`           |
| Soups/Stews                  | `Raw Curry Sauce`          |
|                              | `Curry Sauce`              |
| Filled Bottles/Potions       | `Blood of Igrobzik`        |
|                              | `Lemon Juice`              |
| Kelp (only the model in hand)| `Lemon`                    |
| Swords                       | `Knife`                    |
| Chicken eggs                 | `Igrobzik Spawn Egg`       |
|                              |                            |
|                              |                            |
| Food                         | `Piece of Bread`           |
|                              | `Corn`                     |
| Seeds                        | `Corn Kernels`/`Corn Seeds`|

</details>

`Top Hat +1`/`High Hat +1`/`Topper +1` is `Top Hat`/`High Hat`/`Topper` shifted up by 1 pixel.







<details>
<summary>Русский</summary>

Набор переименований для MSKLI — это набор ресурсов, позволяющий вам переименовывать некоторые предметы и менять этим их модели и/или текстуры.

Вы можете настроить его с помощью мода [Resource Pack Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/respackopts).
